description: UDU (upstream) and LDLT (DESIGN D6) 2..6 on SPD matrices: factors, solve, inverse

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: udu2_u_d
ops.doc: UDU::new(a).unwrap(): a = u * diag(d) * u^T, u unit UPPER triangular (upstream layout)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: ldlt2_l_d
ops.doc: a = l * diag(d) * l^T, l unit LOWER triangular (derived from upstream Cholesky: l = L * diag(L)^-1, d = diag(L)^2)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: udu2_solve
ops.doc: x = u^-T * diag(d)^-1 * u^-1 * b from UDU::new(a) (same x for an LDLT solve)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: udu2_inverse
ops.doc: a^-1 = u^-T * diag(d)^-1 * u^-1 from UDU::new(a) (same inverse for LDLT)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
